The second call consumes that analysis, directly receives all common inputs, and binds one complete executable policy capsule. The final call consumes only that capsule, cannot reacquire external sources or revise its semantics, and emits the same sole policy.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Relocate the single irreversible semantic-closure boundary to a fully informed penultimate call and pass its complete executable policy capsule across an identity-only terminal edge.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Evidence conflicts are resolved before source loss, policy commitments stabilize earlier, and final emission cannot introduce reinterpretive drift.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The champion requires a source-filtered terminal authority to reconstruct a complete policy from non-policy analysis, causing semantic commitment and contract discharge to occur only after evidence compression.

structural_mutation.after: Semantic closure occurs in a fully informed penultimate authority; the terminal call sees only the resulting complete policy capsule and has identity-preserving emission authority.
structural_mutation.before: Semantic closure occurs inside a terminal policy authority operating under a permanent generative-source cut.
structural_mutation.why_structural: The mutation relocates the lineage's irreversible state transition and consequently changes commitment timing, downstream revision authority, and terminal visibility.
